title: Design System: AI 额度看板

display.purpose: The default window's remaining amount. 2rem, weight 600, tracking -0.04em. 1.75rem below 800px.

headline.purpose: The page title. 1.75rem, weight 600, tracking -0.03em. 1.4rem below 800px.

title.purpose: The source name on a line. 16px, weight 600, tracking -0.02em.

body.purpose: Page text. 15px, weight 400, line-height 1.45, tabular figures.

label.purpose: Status, figure caption, and footer at 12px. Stations are 11px. Errors and refresh status are 13px.

motion.name: train-glide
motion.purpose: The page train slides to the used fraction. Reduced motion removes the transition.

components.css: .ds-line { --route: #c2410c; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(148px, 190px) minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 8px 28px; align-items: center; padding: 18px 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9d6cc; font-family: "Quota Sans", "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #141414; } .ds-id { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-swatch { width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-top: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--route); flex: none; } .ds-name { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-status { margin: 2px 0 0; color: #3f463f; font-size: 12px; } .ds-track { position: relative; height: 2px; margin: 18px 12px 36px; background: var(--route); border-radius: 0; } .ds-track::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: -1px; top: 50%; width: 7px; height: 7px; border: 1.5px solid #141414; background: #f7f7f5; transform: translate(50%, -50%) rotate(45deg); } .ds-train { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: calc(var(--at, 0) * (100% - 12px)); width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--route); transform: translateY(-50%); transition: left 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-stations { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-station { position: absolute; left: calc(var(--at, 0) * 100%); top: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; transform: translateX(-50%); color: #3f463f; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-lead { color: #141414; font-weight: 600; } .ds-figure { margin: 0; text-align: right; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1; } .ds-figure small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; color: #3f463f; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-train { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Each subscription is a line on a light platform. The ground is warm off-white, the type is near-black, and the only saturated color on a line is that source's route. A filled disc, the train, sits at the fraction already used. The right end of the page track is a diamond, the terminus. Lines stack down the page. They are not cards, and they do not share a brand accent.

The column is 1120px. Identity sits on the left, the track and its stations in the middle, and the default window's remaining amount on the right in large tabular figures. A station with a number sits at that window's used fraction and prints the amount still left. A window with no number stays empty: the train and the diamond are absent, and the station does not read as zero. Latin letters and digits use self-hosted Source Sans 3. Chinese uses the system gothic in the same stack.

The Harness strip is the same diagram compressed into the composer: the same route colors, a 2px track, and a smaller disc. Its buttons, corner radius, elevation, and label color belong to the host and are not material of this world.
keyCharacteristics: One route color per source, on the swatch, the track, and the healthy train
The train marks the used fraction; the page track ends in a ground-filled diamond
Exhausted and low recolor the train and the remainder; the track keeps its route
Flat platform: a 2px ink header rule, 1px joints, no shadow tokens
Tabular Source Sans 3 for digits; system gothic for Chinese
Ink actions with 2px corners, on a light platform only

rules.name: The Route Rule
rules.body: Each source has one route color. It paints the identity swatch, the 2px track, and the train while that window is healthy. It is not a card fill, a page background, or another source's color.

rules.name: The State Override Rule
rules.body: On the page, a remainder at or below zero paints the train and the large figure Terminus Red. A remainder at or below one fifth of a known total paints them Low Amber. The track stays the route color. Failed status and error text also use Terminus Red. The strip recolors the remainder with those same two colors, and it treats a percent window as a total of 100 when choosing Low Amber.

rules.name: The Split Face Rule
rules.body: Quota Sans is self-hosted Source Sans 3 at weights 400 and 600, limited to Latin (U+0000–00FF). Chinese falls through to PingFang SC, then Noto Sans SC, then sans-serif. Do not add a display face.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is weight 600. The face does not ship 500 or 700, and new text does not ask for them.

rules.name: The Horizontal Line Rule
rules.body: A source is one row: identity, track, remainder. Rows stack in a single column. They do not become a card grid.

rules.name: The Station Placement Rule
rules.body: A window with a number sits at its used fraction and prints the amount left. A window without a number is spaced evenly and stays unlabeled as zero. The default window is the lead station, in ink at weight 600, and its amount is repeated in the figure.

rules.name: The Flat Platform Rule
rules.body: Surfaces do not lift. The header closes with a 2px ink rule, each line closes with a 1px Platform Joint, and focus is a 2px ink outline 3px outside the control. No shadow is a token.

rules.name: The Disc and Diamond Rule
rules.body: The train is a filled disc: 12px on the page, 8px on the popover track, 6px in the strip. The page track ends in a 7px diamond with a 1.5px ink stroke and a Platform Ground fill, rotated 45 degrees. Tracks are square-ended. Actions are 2px rectangles. An idle line hides both the train and the diamond.

dos: Do paint each source's swatch, 2px track, and healthy train with that source's route color.
Do park the train at the used fraction, left for a full remainder and right for an empty one.
Do end the page track with a 7px diamond: 1.5px ink stroke, Platform Ground fill, rotated 45 degrees.

Do recolor the train and the large remainder with Terminus Red when the remainder is zero or below, and with Low Amber when it is at or below one fifth of a known total. Leave the track in the route color.
Do set digits in Quota Sans (Source Sans 3, 400 and 600, Latin) and Chinese in PingFang SC, then Noto Sans SC, then sans-serif, with tabular figures.
Do leave a missing window empty: no train, no diamond, and no zero in place of an unread amount.
Do keep the Harness strip on the same route colors and a 2px track, with a 6px disc in the strip and an 8px disc on the popover track.
donts: Don't wrap a source in a card, a tinted well, or a second background.
Don't invent a shared brand accent, or paint one source with another source's route.
Don't draw a missing window as zero.
Don't add drop shadows, gradients, or a dark theme. The page sets color-scheme to light.
Don't add a display typeface, a weight other than 400 and 600, or a glyph icon system for this world.
Don't round the track, fill it as a bar, or replace the page diamond with an arrow.
Don't restyle the Harness controls with the page's ink buttons. Host radius, elevation, and focus stay with the host.
